name: manim-plugin
description: Create, edit, render, inspect, debug, migrate, and export production Manim animations with a fast local director engine and workbench.

interface.shortDescription: Direct and ship production Manim animations
interface.longDescription: Turn an idea, equation, dataset, paper, narration, or existing Manim project into a storyboarded, rendered, visually inspected animation. Manim Director keeps large logs and media out of model context while providing precise create, edit, render, debug, migrate, QA, and export workflows through a fast local engine and interactive workbench.
defaultPrompt: Create and render a Manim explanation from this idea
Fix this Manim scene and inspect the result
Open my Manim project in the visual workbench
